verses.ar: الٓرٰࣞ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِࣞ‏
verses.en: Alif Lām Rā. These are verses of the enlightening Book.

verses.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: We have sent it down, as an Arabic Qur’an, so that you may understand.

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ اَحۡسَنَ الۡقَصَصِ بِمَا٘ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَࣗۖ وَاِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ لَمِنَ الۡغٰفِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: By revealing this Qur’an to you, we hereby narrate to you the best narrative, while before this you were among those unaware (of it).

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ يُوۡسُفُ لِاَبِيۡهِ يٰ٘اَبَتِ اِنِّيۡ رَاَيۡتُ اَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبًا وَّالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ رَاَيۡتُهُمۡ لِيۡ سٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: (It happened) when Yūsuf said to his father, “My father, I saw (in dream) eleven stars and the Sun and the Moon; I saw them all fallen prostrate before me.’’

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰبُنَيَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡيَاكَ عَلٰ٘ي اِخۡوَتِكَ فَيَكِيۡدُوۡا لَكَ كَيۡدًاؕ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ لِلۡاِنۡسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: He said, “My son, do not relate your dream to your brothers, lest they should devise a plan against you. Surely, Satan is an open enemy for mankind.

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ يَجۡتَبِيۡكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِنۡ تَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحَادِيۡثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهٗ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلٰ٘ي اٰلِ يَعۡقُوۡبَ كَمَا٘ اَتَمَّهَا عَلٰ٘ي اَبَوَيۡكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡحٰقَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيۡمٌ حَكِيۡمٌࣖ‏
verses.en: And it will be in this way that your Lord will choose you and teach you the correct interpretation of events, and will perfect His bounty upon you and upon the House of Ya‘qūb, as He has perfected it earlier upon your fore-fathers, Ibrāhīm and IsHāq. Surely, your Lord is All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِيۡ يُوۡسُفَ وَاِخۡوَتِهٖ٘ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلسَّآئِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in (the story of) Yūsuf and his brothers, there are signs for those who ask.

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالُوۡا لَيُوۡسُفُ وَاَخُوۡهُ اَحَبُّ اِلٰ٘ي اَبِيۡنَا مِنَّا وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌؕ اِنَّ اَبَانَا لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنِۙۖ‏
verses.en: (It happened) when they said, “Yūsuf and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, while we are a whole group. Surely, our father is in clear error.

verses.ar: اِۨقۡتُلُوۡا يُوۡسُفَ اَوِ اطۡرَحُوۡهُ اَرۡضًا يَّخۡلُ لَكُمۡ وَجۡهُ اَبِيۡكُمۡ وَتَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ قَوۡمًا صٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: Let us kill Yūsuf, or throw him at some place on earth, and thus your father’s full attention will be devoted for you alone, and after doing that, you may become a righteous people.’’

verses.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ لَا تَقۡتُلُوۡا يُوۡسُفَ وَاَلۡقُوۡهُ فِيۡ غَيٰبَتِ الۡجُبِّ يَلۡتَقِطۡهُ بَعۡضُ السَّيَّارَةِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: One of them said, “Do not kill Yūsuf; rather, cast him into the bottom of a pit, so that some wayfarers may pick him up, if you are going to do something anyway.’’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَاۡمَنَّا عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَنٰصِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said (to Ya‘qūb), “Our father, why is it that you do not trust us about Yūsuf, while we are his well-wishers indeed.

verses.ar: اَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَّرۡتَعۡ وَيَلۡعَبۡ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوۡنَ
verses.en: Send him with us tomorrow, that he may eat and play, and of course, we will remain as guards for him.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنِّيۡ لَيَحۡزُنُنِيۡ٘ اَنۡ تَذۡهَبُوۡا بِهٖ وَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّاۡكُلَهُ الذِّئۡبُ وَاَنۡتُمۡ عَنۡهُ غٰفِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “It makes me sad that you should take him with you, and I fear that some wolf may eat him up when you are heedless of him.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ اَكَلَهُ الذِّئۡبُ وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌ اِنَّا٘ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “If a wolf eats him up, while we are a whole group, we are then losers indeed.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوۡا بِهٖ وَاَجۡمَعُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّجۡعَلُوۡهُ فِيۡ غَيٰبَتِ الۡجُبِّۚ وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُمۡ بِاَمۡرِهِمۡ هٰذَا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: So, when they went away with him and were determined to put him in the bottom of a pit, (they did accordingly). And We revealed to him (Yūsuf), “You will (one day) remind them of this deed of theirs, and they will not recognize (you).”

verses.ar: وَجَآءُوۡ٘ اَبَاهُمۡ عِشَآءً يَّبۡكُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: And at nightfall, they came to their father weeping.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا٘ اِنَّا ذَهَبۡنَا نَسۡتَبِقُ وَتَرَكۡنَا يُوۡسُفَ عِنۡدَ مَتَاعِنَا فَاَكَلَهُ الذِّئۡبُۚ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِمُؤۡمِنٍ لَّنَا وَلَوۡ كُنَّا صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Father, we went racing with one another, and left Yūsuf with our belongings, and the wolf ate him up. You will never believe us, howsoever truthful we may be.”

verses.ar: وَجَآءُوۡ عَلٰي قَمِيۡصِهٖ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍؕ قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ اَنۡفُسُكُمۡ اَمۡرًاؕ فَصَبۡرٌ جَمِيۡلٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰي مَا تَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: And they came with fake blood on his shirt. He said, “Rather, your inner desires have tempted you to do something. So, patience is best. It is Allah whose help is sought against what you describe.’’

verses.ar: وَجَآءَتۡ سَيَّارَةٌ فَاَرۡسَلُوۡا وَارِدَهُمۡ فَاَدۡلٰي دَلۡوَهٗؕ قَالَ يٰبُشۡرٰي هٰذَا غُلٰمٌؕ وَاَسَرُّوۡهُ بِضَاعَةًؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And some wayfarers came (near the pit in which Yūsuf was thrown), and sent their water-drawer (to bring water for them). So, he let down his bucket. He said, “What a good news! Here is a boy.” And they kept him hidden as merchandise, while Allah was aware of what they were doing.

verses.ar: وَشَرَوۡهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخۡسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعۡدُوۡدَةٍۚ وَكَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And they sold him for a paltry price, for a few silver-coins, and they had not much interest in him.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشۡتَرٰىهُ مِنۡ مِّصۡرَ لِامۡرَاَتِهٖ٘ اَكۡرِمِيۡ مَثۡوٰىهُ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَنَا٘ اَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهٗ وَلَدًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوۡسُفَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؗ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهٗ مِنۡ تَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحَادِيۡثِؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَالِبٌ عَلٰ٘ي اَمۡرِهٖ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And the one who bought him from Egypt said to his wife, “Make his stay graceful. He may be useful for us. Or, we may adopt him as a son.” And thus We established Yūsuf in the land, so that We should teach him the interpretation of events. Allah is powerful in (enforcing) His command, but most of the people do not know.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُ حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And when he reached the prime of his age, We gave him wisdom and knowledge, and this is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

verses.ar: وَرَاوَدَتۡهُ الَّتِيۡ هُوَ فِيۡ بَيۡتِهَا عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖ وَغَلَّقَتِ الۡاَبۡوَابَ وَقَالَتۡ هَيۡتَ لَكَؕ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللّٰهِ اِنَّهٗ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَحۡسَنَ مَثۡوَايَؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And she, in whose house he was, seduced him towards herself, and bolted the doors, and said, “come on!” He said, “I seek refuge with Allah. Surely, he (your husband) is my master. He has given me a good lodging. Indeed, the wrongdoers do not prosper.”

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ هَمَّتۡ بِهٖ وَهَمَّ بِهَاۚ لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ رَّاٰ بُرۡهَانَ رَبِّهٖؕ كَذٰلِكَ لِنَصۡرِفَ عَنۡهُ السُّوۡٓءَ وَالۡفَحۡشَآءَؕ اِنَّهٗ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ
verses.en: She certainly desired him, and he might have desired her, had he not seen the proof from his Lord. Thus We did, to turn evil and lewdness away from him. Surely, he was one of Our chosen servants.

verses.ar: وَاسۡتَبَقَا الۡبَابَ وَقَدَّتۡ قَمِيۡصَهٗ مِنۡ دُبُرٍ وَّاَلۡفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا الۡبَابِؕ قَالَتۡ مَا جَزَآءُ مَنۡ اَرَادَ بِاَهۡلِكَ سُوۡٓءًا اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّسۡجَنَ اَوۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: They raced towards the door, and she ripped his shirt from behind, and they found her master by the door. She said, “What could be the punishment of him who intended evil with your wife, except that he be imprisoned or (given) a painful chastisement?”

verses.ar: قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتۡنِيۡ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِيۡ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِهَاۚ اِنۡ كَانَ قَمِيۡصُهٗ قُدَّ مِنۡ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتۡ وَهُوَ مِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: He (Yūsuf) said, “It was she who tried to seduce me.” And a witness from her family observed that if his shirt was ripped from the front side, then she is true and he is a liar;

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ كَانَ قَمِيۡصُهٗ قُدَّ مِنۡ دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتۡ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: and if his shirt was ripped from behind, then she is telling a lie and he is truthful.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاٰ قَمِيۡصَهٗ قُدَّ مِنۡ دُبُرٍ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ مِنۡ كَيۡدِكُنَّؕ اِنَّ كَيۡدَكُنَّ عَظِيۡمٌ
verses.en: So, when he (her husband) saw his shirt ripped from behind, he said, “This is certainly your trickery, O women. Great is the trickery of you women indeed.

verses.ar: يُوۡسُفُ اَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ هٰذَاࣝ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرِيۡ لِذَنۭۡ بِكِۚۖ اِنَّكِ كُنۡتِ مِنَ الۡخٰطِـِٕيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: O Yūsuf, ignore this matter, and you (O woman,) seek forgiveness for your sin, for you were guilty infact.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ نِسۡوَةٌ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ امۡرَاَتُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتٰىهَا عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖۚ قَدۡ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّاؕ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىهَا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: And women in the city said, “The wife of the minister is seducing her youthful slave. His love has entered the depth of her heart. Surely, we see her in open error.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتۡ بِمَكۡرِهِنَّ اَرۡسَلَتۡ اِلَيۡهِنَّ وَاَعۡتَدَتۡ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَاً وَّاٰتَتۡ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِّنۡهُنَّ سِكِّيۡنًا وَّقَالَتِ اخۡرُجۡ عَلَيۡهِنَّۚ فَلَمَّا رَاَيۡنَهٗ٘ اَكۡبَرۡنَهٗ وَقَطَّعۡنَ اَيۡدِيَهُنَّؗ وَقُلۡنَ حَاشَ لِلّٰهِ مَا هٰذَا بَشَرًاؕ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيۡمٌ
verses.en: So, when she heard of their taunting comments, she extended an invitation to them and arranged for them a comfortable place (to sit and dine) and gave everyone a knife, and said (to Yūsuf): “come out to them.” So when they saw him, they found him great, and (were so stunned that they) cut their hands and said, “Oh God! He is no human being. He is but a noble angel.”

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ فَذٰلِكُنَّ الَّذِيۡ لُمۡتُنَّنِيۡ فِيۡهِؕ وَلَقَدۡ رَاوَدۡتُّهٗ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖ فَاسۡتَعۡصَمَؕ وَلَئِنۡ لَّمۡ يَفۡعَلۡ مَا٘ اٰمُرُهٗ لَيُسۡجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُوۡنًا مِّنَ الصّٰغِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: She said, “This is the one about whom you reproached me. Yes, I seduced him, but he abstained. And should he not follow my command, he shall be imprisoned and will be disgraced.”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجۡنُ اَحَبُّ اِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِۚ وَاِلَّا تَصۡرِفۡ عَنِّيۡ كَيۡدَهُنَّ اَصۡبُ اِلَيۡهِنَّ وَاَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: He (Yūsuf) said, “My Lord, the prison is dearer to me than what these women invite me to do. If You do not turn their guile away from me, I shall get inclined towards them and shall be among the ignorant.”

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَجَابَ لَهٗ رَبُّهٗ فَصَرَفَ عَنۡهُ كَيۡدَهُنَّؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: So, his Lord accepted his prayer and turned their guile away from him. Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا رَاَوُا الۡاٰيٰتِ لَيَسۡجُنُنَّهٗ حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Later on, even after having seen the clear signs (of his innocence), they deemed it proper to imprison him for some time.

verses.ar: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجۡنَ فَتَيٰنِؕ قَالَ اَحَدُهُمَا٘ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىنِيۡ٘ اَعۡصِرُ خَمۡرًاۚ وَقَالَ الۡاٰخَرُ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىنِيۡ٘ اَحۡمِلُ فَوۡقَ رَاۡسِيۡ خُبۡزًا تَاۡكُلُ الطَّيۡرُ مِنۡهُؕ نَبِّئۡنَا بِتَاۡوِيۡلِهٖۚ اِنَّا نَرٰىكَ مِنَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And two men entered the prison with him. One of them said, “I have seen myself (in dream) pressing wine.” And the other said, “I saw myself carrying bread on my head of which the birds were eating. Let us know its interpretation. We see you are a man of good deeds.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا يَاۡتِيۡكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرۡزَقٰنِهٖ٘ اِلَّا نَبَّاۡتُكُمَا بِتَاۡوِيۡلِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَكُمَاؕ ذٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِيۡ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنِّيۡ تَرَكۡتُ مِلَّةَ قَوۡمٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “No food provided for you shall come to you, but I can give you its description before it comes to you. This is the knowledge my Lord has given to me. I have abandoned the way of those who do not believe in Allah, and who are deniers of the Hereafter,

verses.ar: وَاتَّبَعۡتُ مِلَّةَ اٰبَآءِيۡ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَؕ مَا كَانَ لَنَا٘ اَنۡ نُّشۡرِكَ بِاللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ فَضۡلِ اللّٰهِ عَلَيۡنَا وَعَلَي النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: and I have followed the way of my fathers, Ibrāhīm, IsHāq and Ya‘qūb. It is not for us that we associate any partners with Allah. All this is a part of the favor Allah has bestowed upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful.

verses.ar: يٰصَاحِبَيِ السِّجۡنِ ءَاَرۡبَابٌ مُّتَفَرِّقُوۡنَ خَيۡرٌ اَمِ اللّٰهُ الۡوَاحِدُ الۡقَهَّارُؕ‏
verses.en: O my fellow prisoners, are different gods better or Allah, the One, the All-Dominant?

verses.ar: مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسۡمَآءً سَمَّيۡتُمُوۡهَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاٰبَآؤُكُمۡ مَّا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ بِهَا مِنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍؕ اِنِ الۡحُكۡمُ اِلَّا لِلّٰهِؕ اَمَرَ اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِيَّاهُؕ ذٰلِكَ الدِّيۡنُ الۡقَيِّمُ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Whatever you worship, other than Him, are nothing but names you have coined, you and your fathers. Allah has sent down no authority for them. Sovereignty belongs to none but Allah. He has ordained that you shall not worship anyone but Him. This is the only right path. But most of the people do not know.”

verses.ar: يٰصَاحِبَيِ السِّجۡنِ اَمَّا٘ اَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسۡقِيۡ رَبَّهٗ خَمۡرًاۚ وَاَمَّا الۡاٰخَرُ فَيُصۡلَبُ فَتَاۡكُلُ الطَّيۡرُ مِنۡ رَّاۡسِهٖؕ قُضِيَ الۡاَمۡرُ الَّذِيۡ فِيۡهِ تَسۡتَفۡتِيٰنِؕ‏
verses.en: “O my fellow prisoners, one of you will serve wine to his master, while the other will be crucified and birds will eat from his head. Destined is the matter you are asking about.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِلَّذِيۡ ظَنَّ اَنَّهٗ نَاجٍ مِّنۡهُمَا اذۡكُرۡنِيۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَؗ فَاَنۡسٰىهُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ ذِكۡرَ رَبِّهٖ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجۡنِ بِضۡعَ سِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And he (Yūsuf) said to the one whom he believed likely to be released out of the two, “Tell your master about me.” Then, the Satan made him forget to tell his master. So, he (Yūsuf) remained in prison for a few years.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلِكُ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰي سَبۡعَ بَقَرٰتٍ سِمَانٍ يَّاۡكُلُهُنَّ سَبۡعٌ عِجَافٌ وَّسَبۡعَ سُنۭۡ بُلٰتٍ خُضۡرٍ وَّاُخَرَ يٰبِسٰتٍؕ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَاُ اَفۡتُوۡنِيۡ فِيۡ رُءۡيَايَ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لِلرُّءۡيَا تَعۡبُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And (one day) the king said (to his courtiers), “I have seen (in a dream) seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, and seven ears of grain which are green and (seven) others which are dry. O people, tell me about my dream, if you can interpret dreams.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَضۡغَاثُ اَحۡلَامٍۚ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِتَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحۡلَامِ بِعٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “(It seems to be) a mishmash of dreams, and we do not know the interpretation of dreams.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡ نَجَا مِنۡهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعۡدَ اُمَّةٍ اَنَا اُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِتَاۡوِيۡلِهٖ فَاَرۡسِلُوۡنِ
verses.en: And said the one who was released (from the prison) out of the two, and recalled (Yūsuf) after a long time, “I shall tell you its interpretation. Just send me (to Yūsuf).”

verses.ar: يُوۡسُفُ اَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيۡقُ اَفۡتِنَا فِيۡ سَبۡعِ بَقَرٰتٍ سِمَانٍ يَّاۡكُلُهُنَّ سَبۡعٌ عِجَافٌ وَّسَبۡعِ سُنۭۡ بُلٰتٍ خُضۡرٍ وَّاُخَرَ يٰبِسٰتٍۙ لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اَرۡجِعُ اِلَي النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Thus he came to the prison and said to Yūsuf “Yūsuf, O the truthful one, tell us about seven fat cows eaten by seven lean ones, and seven ears of grain which are green and (seven) others which are dry, so that I may go back to the people and they may know (the interpretation of the dream.)”

verses.ar: قَالَ تَزۡرَعُوۡنَ سَبۡعَ سِنِيۡنَ دَاَبًاۚ فَمَا حَصَدۡتُّمۡ فَذَرُوۡهُ فِيۡ سُنۭۡ بُلِهٖ٘ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا مِّمَّا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “You will grow crops for seven years consecutively. So, what you have harvested, leave it in its ear, except a little which you eat.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَاۡتِيۡ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ سَبۡعٌ شِدَادٌ يَّاۡكُلۡنَ مَا قَدَّمۡتُمۡ لَهُنَّ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا مِّمَّا تُحۡصِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then seven hard years shall come after that, which shall eat up what you have stored for them, except a little which you preserve (to sow).

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَاۡتِيۡ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِيۡهِ يُغَاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيۡهِ يَعۡصِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Then there shall come after that a year in which people will have rains and in which they will extract juices.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلِكُ ائۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِهٖۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُ الرَّسُوۡلُ قَالَ ارۡجِعۡ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ فَسۡـَٔلۡهُ مَا بَالُ النِّسۡوَةِ الّٰتِيۡ قَطَّعۡنَ اَيۡدِيَهُنَّؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ بِكَيۡدِهِنَّ عَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: And (when this person went back and told the king about the interpretation of the dream), the king said, “Bring him to me.” So, when the messenger came to Yūsuf, he said, “Go back to your lord and ask him, ‘What is the case of the women who cut their hands?’ Surely, my Lord knows well their guile.”

verses.ar: قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُنَّ اِذۡ رَاوَدۡتُّنَّ يُوۡسُفَ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖؕ قُلۡنَ حَاشَ لِلّٰهِ مَا عَلِمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ سُوۡٓءٍؕ قَالَتِ امۡرَاَتُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡـٰٔنَ حَصۡحَصَ الۡحَقُّؗ اَنَا رَاوَدۡتُّهٗ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖ وَاِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: He (the king) said, “What was your case, O women, when you seduced Yūsuf?” They said, “God forbid, we know of no evil in him.” The governor’s wife said, “Now the truth has come to light. I did seduce him, and he is surely truthful.”

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ لِيَعۡلَمَ اَنِّيۡ لَمۡ اَخُنۡهُ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِيۡ كَيۡدَ الۡخَآئِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Then Yūsuf said), “That was because he (the governor) may know that I did not betray him in his absence, and that Allah does not lead the guile of betrayers to success.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اُبَرِّئُ نَفۡسِيۡۚ اِنَّ النَّفۡسَ لَاَمَّارَةٌۭ بِالسُّوۡٓءِ اِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
verses.en: And I do not absolve my inner self of blame. Surely, man’s inner self often incites to evil, unless my Lord shows mercy. Certainly, my Lord is the Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلِكُ ائۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِهٖ٘ اَسۡتَخۡلِصۡهُ لِنَفۡسِيۡۚ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهٗ قَالَ اِنَّكَ الۡيَوۡمَ لَدَيۡنَا مَكِيۡنٌ اَمِيۡنٌ
verses.en: The king said, “Bring him to me, and I shall employ him purely for myself.” So, when he (the king) talked to him, he said (to Yūsuf), “Today you are with us well-placed, fully trusted.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اجۡعَلۡنِيۡ عَلٰي خَزَآئِنِ الۡاَرۡضِۚ اِنِّيۡ حَفِيۡظٌ عَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: He said, “Appoint me to (supervise) the treasures of the land. I am indeed a knowledgeable keeper.”

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوۡسُفَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِۚ يَتَبَوَّاُ مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ يَشَآءُؕ نُصِيۡبُ بِرَحۡمَتِنَا مَنۡ نَّشَآءُ وَلَا نُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And thus We gave Yūsuf power in the land. He could settle in it wherever he wished. We extend Our mercy to whomsoever We will, and We do not let the reward of the righteous people to go to waste.

verses.ar: وَلَاَجۡرُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And the reward of the Hereafter is surely better for those who believe and constantly observe taqwā.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ اِخۡوَةُ يُوۡسُفَ فَدَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَعَرَفَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And came the brothers of Yūsuf and appeared before him. He recognized them, while they did not recognize him.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمۡ بِجَهَازِهِمۡ قَالَ ائۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِاَخٍ لَّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَبِيۡكُمۡۚ اَلَا تَرَوۡنَ اَنِّيۡ٘ اُوۡفِي الۡكَيۡلَ وَاَنَا خَيۡرُ الۡمُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: When he equipped them with their provisions, he said, “Bring to me your other brother from your father’s side. Do you not see that I give full measure, and I extend the best hospitality?

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تَاۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِهٖ فَلَا كَيۡلَ لَكُمۡ عِنۡدِيۡ وَلَا تَقۡرَبُوۡنِ
verses.en: Still, if you do not bring him to me, then you deserve no (further) measure from me, nor shall you approach me any more.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سَنُرَاوِدُ عَنۡهُ اَبَاهُ وَاِنَّا لَفٰعِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “We shall persuade his father about him and we will certainly do it.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِفِتۡيٰنِهِ اجۡعَلُوۡا بِضَاعَتَهُمۡ فِيۡ رِحَالِهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَعۡرِفُوۡنَهَا٘ اِذَا انۡقَلَبُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And he (Yūsuf) said to his boys, “Put their goods in their camel-packs. Perhaps they will recognize it when they go back to their family; perhaps they will come again.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَبِيۡهِمۡ قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الۡكَيۡلُ فَاَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا٘ اَخَانَا نَكۡتَلۡ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوۡنَ
verses.en: So, when they returned to their father, they said, “Father, the (required) measure (of grain) has been withheld from us, therefore, send our brother with us, so that we may receive our full measure. And, of course, we are his guards.”

verses.ar: قَالَ هَلۡ اٰمَنُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اِلَّا كَمَا٘ اَمِنۡتُكُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَخِيۡهِ مِنۡ قَبۡلُؕ فَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ حٰفِظًاࣕ وَّهُوَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Shall I trust you about him as I trusted you earlier about his brother? Well, Allah is the best guardian, and He is the Most-Merciful of all the merciful.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوۡا مَتَاعَهُمۡ وَجَدُوۡا بِضَاعَتَهُمۡ رُدَّتۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡؕ قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا مَا نَبۡغِيۡؕ هٰذِهٖ بِضَاعَتُنَا رُدَّتۡ اِلَيۡنَاۚ وَنَمِيۡرُ اَهۡلَنَا وَنَحۡفَظُ اَخَانَا وَنَزۡدَادُ كَيۡلَ بَعِيۡرٍؕ ذٰلِكَ كَيۡلٌ يَّسِيۡرٌ
verses.en: When they opened their baggage, they found their goods given back to them. They said, “Our father, what else should we want? Here is our goods given back to us, and we shall bring food to our family, protect our brother and add the measure of one camel more. That is an easy measure.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَنۡ اُرۡسِلَهٗ مَعَكُمۡ حَتّٰي تُؤۡتُوۡنِ مَوۡثِقًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ لَتَاۡتُنَّنِيۡ بِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّحَاطَ بِكُمۡۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اٰتَوۡهُ مَوۡثِقَهُمۡ قَالَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي مَا نَقُوۡلُ وَكِيۡلٌ
verses.en: He said, “I shall never send him with you until you give me a pledge in the name of Allah that you will definitely bring him back to me, unless you are overpowered (by circumstances).” So, when they gave him their pledge, he said, “Allah is watchful over what we say.”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ يٰبَنِيَّ لَا تَدۡخُلُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَابٍ وَّاحِدٍ وَّادۡخُلُوۡا مِنۡ اَبۡوَابٍ مُّتَفَرِّقَةٍؕ وَمَا٘ اُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنِ الۡحُكۡمُ اِلَّا لِلّٰهِؕ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۚ وَعَلَيۡهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُتَوَكِّلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And he said, “O my sons, do not enter (the city) all of you from the same gate, rather, enter from different gates. And I cannot help you in any way against (the will of) Allah. Sovereignty belongs to none but Allah. In Him I place my trust, and all those who trust should trust in Him alone.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا مِنۡ حَيۡثُ اَمَرَهُمۡ اَبُوۡهُمۡؕ مَا كَانَ يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ اِلَّا حَاجَةً فِيۡ نَفۡسِ يَعۡقُوۡبَ قَضٰىهَاؕ وَاِنَّهٗ لَذُوۡ عِلۡمٍ لِّمَا عَلَّمۡنٰهُ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And (recall) when they entered (the city) in the manner their father had advised them. He could not help them in any way against (the will of) Allah, but it was just an urge in the heart of Ya‘qūb which he satisfied; he was a man of knowledge, because We had taught him, but most of the people do not know.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ اٰوٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِ اَخَاهُ قَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا اَخُوۡكَ فَلَا تَبۡتَئِسۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And when they came to Yūsuf, he lodged his brother (Binyamin) with himself. He said, “Look, I am your brother! So do not grieve for what they have been doing.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمۡ بِجَهَازِهِمۡ جَعَلَ السِّقَايَةَ فِيۡ رَحۡلِ اَخِيۡهِ ثُمَّ اَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ اَيَّتُهَا الۡعِيۡرُ اِنَّكُمۡ لَسٰرِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Later, when he equipped them with their provisions, he placed the bowl in the camel-pack of his brother. Then, an announcer shouted out, “O people of the caravan, you are thieves.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا وَاَقۡبَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّاذَا تَفۡقِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Turning towards them, they said, “What are you missing?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا نَفۡقِدُ صُوَاعَ الۡمَلِكِ وَلِمَنۡ جَآءَ بِهٖ حِمۡلُ بَعِيۡرٍ وَّاَنَا بِهٖ زَعِيۡمٌ
verses.en: They said, “We are missing the measuring-bowl of the king, and whoever brings it back shall deserve a camel-load, and I stand surety for it.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمۡ مَّا جِئۡنَا لِنُفۡسِدَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كُنَّا سٰرِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “We swear by Allah, you know, we did not come to make mischief in the land, nor have we ever been thieves.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا فَمَا جَزَآؤُهٗ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ كٰذِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “What is the punishment, if you are liars?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا جَزَآؤُهٗ مَنۡ وُّجِدَ فِيۡ رَحۡلِهٖ فَهُوَ جَزَآؤُهٗؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Its punishment? The one in whose saddlebag it is found shall himself be the punishment. This is how we punish the wrongdoers.”

verses.ar: فَبَدَاَ بِاَوۡعِيَتِهِمۡ قَبۡلَ وِعَآءِ اَخِيۡهِ ثُمَّ اسۡتَخۡرَجَهَا مِنۡ وِّعَآءِ اَخِيۡهِؕ كَذٰلِكَ كِدۡنَا لِيُوۡسُفَؕ مَا كَانَ لِيَاۡخُذَ اَخَاهُ فِيۡ دِيۡنِ الۡمَلِكِ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ نَرۡفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنۡ نَّشَآءُؕ وَفَوۡقَ كُلِّ ذِيۡ عِلۡمٍ عَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: So, he started with their bags before (searching) the bag of his brother, then, recovered it from the bag of his brother.This is how We planned for Yūsuf. He had no right to take his brother according to the law of the king, unless Allah so willed. We elevate in ranks whomsoever We will. Above every man of knowledge, there is someone more knowledgeable.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ يَّسۡرِقۡ فَقَدۡ سَرَقَ اَخٌ لَّهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُۚ فَاَسَرَّهَا يُوۡسُفُ فِيۡ نَفۡسِهٖ وَلَمۡ يُبۡدِهَا لَهُمۡۚ قَالَ اَنۡتُمۡ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًاۚ وَاللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “If he commits theft, (there is nothing surprising, because) his other brother had committed theft earlier.” Yūsuf kept it (his reaction) to himself and did not reveal it to them. He said (in his heart), “You are even worse in position. Allah knows best of what you allege.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡعَزِيۡزُ اِنَّ لَهٗ٘ اَبًا شَيۡخًا كَبِيۡرًا فَخُذۡ اَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهٗۚ اِنَّا نَرٰىكَ مِنَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “O ‘Azīz, he has a father, a very old man. So, take one of us in his place. We see you are a generous man.”

verses.ar: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللّٰهِ اَنۡ نَّاۡخُذَ اِلَّا مَنۡ وَّجَدۡنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِنۡدَهٗ٘ۙ اِنَّا٘ اِذًا لَّظٰلِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: He said, “We seek Allah’s refuge from keeping anyone other than him with whom we have found our thing, otherwise we shall be unjust.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا اسۡتَيۡـَٔسُوۡا مِنۡهُ خَلَصُوۡا نَجِيًّاؕ قَالَ كَبِيۡرُهُمۡ اَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ اَبَاكُمۡ قَدۡ اَخَذَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مَّوۡثِقًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلُ مَا فَرَّطۡتُّمۡ فِيۡ يُوۡسُفَۚ فَلَنۡ اَبۡرَحَ الۡاَرۡضَ حَتّٰي يَاۡذَنَ لِيۡ٘ اَبِيۡ٘ اَوۡ يَحۡكُمَ اللّٰهُ لِيۡۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ الۡحٰكِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: So when they lost hope in him, they went aside for consultation. The oldest of them said, “Do you not know that your father has taken pledge from you in the name of Allah, while you had defaulted earlier in the case of Yūsuf. So, I shall never leave this land unless my father permits me or Allah decides about me. He is the best of all judges.

verses.ar: اِرۡجِعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَبِيۡكُمۡ فَقُوۡلُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا٘ اِنَّ ابۡنَكَ سَرَقَۚ وَمَا شَهِدۡنَا٘ اِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمۡنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلۡغَيۡبِ حٰفِظِيۡنَ
verses.en: Go back to your father and say, ‘Our father, your son has committed theft, and we do not testify except what we know, and we could not guard against the unseen.

verses.ar: وَسۡـَٔلِ الۡقَرۡيَةَ الَّتِيۡ كُنَّا فِيۡهَا وَالۡعِيۡرَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَقۡبَلۡنَا فِيۡهَاؕ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Ask (the people of) the town in which we have been, and the caravan with which we have come, and undoubtedly we are truthful.”

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ اَنۡفُسُكُمۡ اَمۡرًاؕ فَصَبۡرٌ جَمِيۡلٌؕ عَسَي اللّٰهُ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَنِيۡ بِهِمۡ جَمِيۡعًاؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَلِيۡمُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
verses.en: He (Ya‘qūb) said, “Rather, your inner desires have seduced you to something. So, patience is best. Hopefully, Allah may bring them all together. Surely, He is the All-Knowing, All-Wise.”

verses.ar: وَتَوَلّٰي عَنۡهُمۡ وَقَالَ يٰ٘اَسَفٰي عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ وَابۡيَضَّتۡ عَيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡحُزۡنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ
verses.en: He turned away from them and said, “How sad I am about Yūsuf!” and his eyes turned white with sorrow and he was suppressing (his anger and grief).

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ تَفۡتَؤُا تَذۡكُرُ يُوۡسُفَ حَتّٰي تَكُوۡنَ حَرَضًا اَوۡ تَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡهٰلِكِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “By God, you will not stop remembering Yūsuf until you collapse or perish.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَا٘ اَشۡكُوۡا بَثِّيۡ وَحُزۡنِيۡ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَاَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “I do not complain of my anguish and sorrow to anyone but Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.

verses.ar: يٰبَنِيَّ اذۡهَبُوۡا فَتَحَسَّسُوۡا مِنۡ يُّوۡسُفَ وَاَخِيۡهِ وَلَا تَايۡـَٔسُوۡا مِنۡ رَّوۡحِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يَايۡـَٔسُ مِنۡ رَّوۡحِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الۡقَوۡمُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: O my sons, go and search for Yūsuf and his brother, and do not lose hope in the mercy of Allah. In fact, only the infidels lose hope in Allah’s mercy.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡعَزِيۡزُ مَسَّنَا وَاَهۡلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئۡنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُّزۡجٰىةٍ فَاَوۡفِ لَنَا الۡكَيۡلَ وَتَصَدَّقۡ عَلَيۡنَاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَجۡزِي الۡمُتَصَدِّقِيۡنَ
verses.en: So, when they came to him (Yūsuf), they said, “‘Azīz, we and our family are struck by distress, and we have brought some goods of very little worth. So, give us the full measure (of grain) and be charitable to us. Surely, Allah rewards the charitable.”

verses.ar: قَالَ هَلۡ عَلِمۡتُمۡ مَّا فَعَلۡتُمۡ بِيُوۡسُفَ وَاَخِيۡهِ اِذۡ اَنۡتُمۡ جٰهِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Do you know what you did to Yūsuf and his brother when you were ignorant?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاِنَّكَ لَاَنۡتَ يُوۡسُفُؕ قَالَ اَنَا يُوۡسُفُ وَهٰذَا٘ اَخِيۡؗ قَدۡ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ مَنۡ يَّتَّقِ وَيَصۡبِرۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Is it that you are, in fact, Yūsuf?” He said, “I am Yūsuf, and this is my brother. Allah has been very kind to us. Surely, whoever fears Allah and observes patience, Allah does not let the reward of such good people to go to waste.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدۡ اٰثَرَكَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَاِنۡ كُنَّا لَخٰطِـِٕيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “We swear by Allah, indeed Allah has given to you preference over us, and we were guilty in fact.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تَثۡرِيۡبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَؕ يَغۡفِرُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمۡؗ وَهُوَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “No reproach upon you today! May Allah forgive you, and He is the Most- Merciful of all the merciful.

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبُوۡا بِقَمِيۡصِيۡ هٰذَا فَاَلۡقُوۡهُ عَلٰي وَجۡهِ اَبِيۡ يَاۡتِ بَصِيۡرًاۚ وَاۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِاَهۡلِكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Go with this shirt of mine, and put it over the face of my father, and he will turn into a sighted man. And bring to me all your family.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الۡعِيۡرُ قَالَ اَبُوۡهُمۡ اِنِّيۡ لَاَجِدُ رِيۡحَ يُوۡسُفَ لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ تُفَنِّدُوۡنِ
verses.en: And when the caravan set out (from Egypt), their father (Ya‘qūb) said (in Canaan), “I sense the fragrance of Yūsuf, if you do not take me to be senile.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ اِنَّكَ لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلِكَ الۡقَدِيۡمِ
verses.en: They said, “By God, you are still in your old fallacy!”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَنۡ جَآءَ الۡبَشِيۡرُ اَلۡقٰىهُ عَلٰي وَجۡهِهٖ فَارۡتَدَّ بَصِيۡرًاؕۚ قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّكُمۡۚ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: So, when came the man with good news, he put it (the shirt) on his face, and he turned into a sighted man. He (Ya‘qūb) said, “Did I not tell you that I know from Allah what you do not know?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا اسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا خٰطِـِٕيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Our father, pray to Allah to forgive us our sins. Surely, we have been guilty.”

verses.ar: قَالَ سَوۡفَ اَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكُمۡ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
verses.en: He said, “I shall pray to my Lord to forgive you. Surely, He is the Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ اٰوٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِ اَبَوَيۡهِ وَقَالَ ادۡخُلُوۡا مِصۡرَ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ اٰمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Later, when they came to Yūsuf, he placed his parents near himself and said, “Enter Egypt, God willing, in peace.”

verses.ar: وَرَفَعَ اَبَوَيۡهِ عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِ وَخَرُّوۡا لَهٗ سُجَّدًاۚ وَقَالَ يٰ٘اَبَتِ هٰذَا تَاۡوِيۡلُ رُءۡيَايَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُؗ قَدۡ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّيۡ حَقًّاؕ وَقَدۡ اَحۡسَنَ بِيۡ٘ اِذۡ اَخۡرَجَنِيۡ مِنَ السِّجۡنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡبَدۡوِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ اَنۡ نَّزَغَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَ اِخۡوَتِيۡؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ لَطِيۡفٌ لِّمَا يَشَآءُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَلِيۡمُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
verses.en: And he raised his parents up on the throne, and they all fell before him in prostration. He said, “My father, here is the fulfillment of my early dream. My Lord has made it come true. He favored me when he released me from the prison, and brought you from the countryside after Satan had caused a rift between me and my brothers. Surely, my Lord does what He wills in a subtle way. Surely, He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.”

verses.ar: رَبِّ قَدۡ اٰتَيۡتَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِيۡ مِنۡ تَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحَادِيۡثِۚ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِࣞ اَنۡتَ وَلِيّٖ فِي الدُّنۡيَا وَالۡاٰخِرَةِۚ تَوَفَّنِيۡ مُسۡلِمًا وَّاَلۡحِقۡنِيۡ بِالصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: “My Lord, You have given me power to rule and the knowledge of interpreting events. O Creator of the heavens and the Earth, You are my guardian in this world and the Hereafter. Make me die a Muslim and make me join the righteous.”

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الۡغَيۡبِ نُوۡحِيۡهِ اِلَيۡكَۚ وَمَا كُنۡتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ اِذۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: That is a part of the reports of the unseen We reveal to you (O Prophet). You were not with them when they determined their object, and when they were planning devices.

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَكۡثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوۡ حَرَصۡتَ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Most of the people are not going to believe despite your strong desire for it.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And you do not demand from them any reward against it. It is nothing but a reminder for all the (people of the) worlds.

verses.ar: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ يَمُرُّوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا وَهُمۡ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: How many a sign there are in the heavens and the Earth, which they pass by and they are heedless to them;

verses.ar: وَمَا يُؤۡمِنُ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ بِاللّٰهِ اِلَّا وَهُمۡ مُّشۡرِكُوۡنَ
verses.en: and most of them do not believe in Allah without associating partners with Him in His divinity.

verses.ar: اَفَاَمِنُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ غَاشِيَةٌ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do they feel themselves secure from the visit of Allah’s encircling punishment or from the sudden arrival of the Hour, while they are not conscious of it?

verses.ar: قُلۡ هٰذِهٖ سَبِيۡلِيۡ٘ اَدۡعُوۡ٘ا اِلَي اللّٰهِࣞؔ عَلٰي بَصِيۡرَةٍ اَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِيۡؕ وَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَمَا٘ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
verses.en: Say, “This is my way. I call (people) to Allah with full perception, both I and my followers. Pure is Allah; and I am not among those who associate partners with Allah.”

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡقُرٰيؕ اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ وَلَدَارُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡاؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: We did not send before you (messengers) other than men from the people of the towns whom We inspired with revelation. Have they not traveled in the land where they could have seen how was the fate of those before them? And surely the abode of the Hereafter is much better for those who fear Allah. Would you, then, still not understand?

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا اسۡتَيۡـَٔسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ قَدۡ كُذِبُوۡا جَآءَهُمۡ نَصۡرُنَاۙ فَنُجِّيَ مَنۡ نَّشَآءُؕ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَاۡسُنَا عَنِ الۡقَوۡمِ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Punishment was often delayed) until when the messengers were in despair and thought that they were wrong in their estimation, Our help came to them, then saved were those whom We willed. And Our punishment is not averted from the guilty.

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِيۡ قَصَصِهِمۡ عِبۡرَةٌ لِّاُولِي الۡاَلۡبَابِؕ مَا كَانَ حَدِيۡثًا يُّفۡتَرٰي وَلٰكِنۡ تَصۡدِيۡقَ الَّذِيۡ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيۡلَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Surely, in the narratives of these, there is a lesson for the people of understanding. It is not an invented story, rather, a confirmation of what has been before it, and an elaboration of everything, and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
